selected_script.angle: Trying to wedge a paper-towel-wrapped butter knife into a greasy stove seam just tears the paper; Liapu Spray quickly penetrates and dissolves that trapped grease, then easily cuts through heavy oil on range hoods and microwaves for a 99.9% antibacterial clean.
selected_script.hook: Stop digging grease out of your stove seams with a butter knife!

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video. Realistic handheld phone-shot style. No generated text, icons, or subtitles. Timeline: 0-3s: Show a real-life wrong behavior—close-up POV trying to dig thick grease out of a stove seam using a butter knife wrapped in a paper towel; the paper tears and sticky grease remains. 3-6s: Quickly introduce the product. A hand sprays the Liapu spray bottle into the greasy seam, dissolving the heavy oil instantly. 6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing a cloth effortlessly wiping the seam clean. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA in this segment. Keep the pacing fast, clear, and product-focused. Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity. Do not change the product color (white bottle, yellow label), shape, material, size ratio, logo position, texture, or visible structure. Do not invent extra accessories.
